title: Iolo
summary_html:
Iolo FitzOwen [yoh-loh], a well-known bard, bowyer and adventurer, is a recurring character in the Ultima series and numbers among the companions of the Avatar. A native of Earth,[1] Iolo possesses a longevity typical of many Terrans dwelling in Britannia. As a citizen of the realm, he has lived for many centuries.

In the opening dialogue in Ultima VII: The Black Gate he is described as a "rather large" man.
